annular_contact_semantics.scope: Recovered full tire boundary and future native contact normal/witness/manifold semantics, including side/inner/bore behavior.
annular_contact_semantics.warning: Donor outer-P75 rolling evidence does not dynamically validate this lane.

donor_outer_carrier_dynamics.scope: Recovered donor b3Wheel outer-P75 carrier used for bounded rolling, topology-transition, traction and mount/orientation feasibility experiments.
donor_outer_carrier_dynamics.warning: Evidence in this lane does not validate full annular side/inner/bore semantics.

lastOwnerHandsOn.scope: Touch steering ownership/release/re-grab and configurable wheel-range current-best. Natural physical self-return, wheel/contact physics, drivetrain, suspension, final rig and handling remain open.

activeApparatus.rule: The explicit RH0 suite remains the hardened donor-carrier replay base. RQ2C4D/E/F are transient read-only diagnostics on exact RQ2C4 physics. The RQ2C orientation micro-line is closed at zero-degree HOLD; do not extend it automatically.

sentinels.meaning: At matched 0.20*mu*m*g*R pulses, drive shows much larger transient rolling slip than braking while remaining stable and relaxing after torque removal.
sentinels.reopenTrigger: A later representative mount/orientation/load case materially amplifies the asymmetry or makes it consequential for grip, energy, handling or Owner-observable behavior.

records.question: Does the recovered annular boundary/contact trajectory converge with tessellation, and are raw triangle-manifold normals suitable physical semantics?
records.scope: Diagnostic only: boundary location converges while raw side/inner triangle-manifold normal is not a viable direct dynamic normal semantic.
records.open: Dynamic manifold/normal semantics and side/inner/bore solver behavior remain unvalidated.

records.question: Can a profile-derived analytic normal fix the E1b side/inner discontinuity without becoming a universal but incorrect substitution?
records.scope: Analytic normal is strongly continuous for the side/inner control; broad flat support favors native pair normal and exposes witness ownership as a separate problem.
records.open: No dynamic solver has consumed a regime-aware semantic.

records.question: Can the known recycler reprojection amplification be cleanly attributed to one absolute frame/anchor component?
records.scope: Bounded fixed-road forensic apparatus: reprojection is a necessary amplifier, but its residual is an ill-conditioned cancellation and cannot be causally assigned by absolute component magnitude.
records.reopenTrigger: Later representative wheel evidence demonstrates material harm plausibly linked to recycler/reprojection behavior.

records.question: Can the donor outer-P75 carrier sustain frictional steady rolling on a true flat static road with an aligned planar guide?
records.scope: Outer-P75, flat road, 1 m/s, mu=0.9, aligned world-axis planar guide; zero dropout/churn and microscopic slip with a zero-spin friction positive control.
records.open: Not a representative tilted-wheel mount and not full annular/side/inner/bore validation.

records.question: Does the first pinned-hull-preserved road-normal feature transition add material disturbance above RQ0 background?
records.scope: 30 microradian longitudinal road-normal kink; one intended feature transition, zero dropout, point count 1..1, no material disturbance above matched flat control.
records.open: Bounded laboratory topology transition only, not a broad rough-road envelope.

records.question: Does a small signed relative-normal/cross-slope perturbation matter while support-feature identity stays unchanged?
records.scope: 0/+10/-10 microradian transverse road rotation; same effective support feature, zero dropout/churn and effectively neutral response.
records.open: Does not validate mechanically free camber/steer or profile-support transitions.

records.question: Does bounded rolling evidence justify reopening recycler micro-forensics or a production recycler mitigation?
records.decision: Q1-A: no material recycler/contact pathology demonstrated in the tested bounded laboratory rolling-transition envelope; recycler micro-forensics stay closed by default.
records.reopenTrigger: A later physically justified representative case demonstrates material contact/energy/grip/chassis disturbance for which recycler attribution can change the decision.

records.question: Can the RQ0 apparatus transmit a bounded sub-limit braking torque without material contact instability?
records.scope: 0.20*mu*m*g*R braking pulse for 0.5 s on aligned flat-road RQ0-derived apparatus; zero dropout/churn and essentially exact translation-spin coordination.
records.open: No near-limit braking, lockup, load transfer or complete traction curve.

records.question: Can the same apparatus transmit the opposite bounded drive torque without material contact instability?
records.scope: Matched 0.20*mu*m*g*R drive pulse for 0.5 s; zero dropout/churn and post-pulse return to near-zero slip.
records.open: Drive/brake transient slip is sign-asymmetric; retain as sentinel rather than explaining microscopically without later material relevance.

records.question: Does a 120 Hz local-axis ParallelJoint guide preserve RQ0-like rolling while holding wheel-axis orientation?
records.invalidMeasurement: Axle tilt computed with acos(axis.z) in float precision could report false zero for small real tilt.
records.scope: Tilt claim invalid; observational telemetry failure does not automatically invalidate contact/rolling dynamics.

records.question: With stable small-angle telemetry, how does the 120 Hz local-axis angular guide compare with RQ0 and what compliance does it exhibit?
records.outcome: Contact/rolling equivalence supportive; historical predeclared <100 microradian axle-tilt gate failed at 148.785 microradians (0.008525 degrees).
records.scope: Synthetic local-axis angular guide: static reference + ParallelJoint with inherited world linear-Z guide; mount-feasibility apparatus, not representative suspension/axle.
records.open: The historical 100 microradian gate was not derived from product or next-challenge error budget; RH0.5 now supplies a separate challenge-derived budget for the next experiment.

records.question: Would a predeclared 240 Hz local-axis-guide follow-up reduce compliance under otherwise identical apparatus?
records.scope: No Box3D build or physics runtime occurred. No 240 Hz result exists.
records.routing: Do not repair/rerun as a stiffness campaign; the failure motivated RH0 apparatus hardening.

records.question: Can frozen canonical RQ helpers coexist in one pinned build/process and reproduce their defining signals before active-harness consolidation?
records.scope: Migration oracle only: legacy canonical helpers composed into one build and normalized under the frozen replay contract; no new physics scope.

records.question: Can one explicit versioned C++ scenario suite plus a thin adapter replace the active RQ patch chain without changing canonical donor-carrier behavior?
records.scope: RH0 non-drift qualification. Explicit suite reproduced frozen canonical metrics essentially bit-for-bit, including RQ1 topology and the RQ2 sign-asymmetry sentinel; this authorizes apparatus provenance cutover, not new physics or product acceptance.

records.question: What is the first physically grounded non-world-aligned orientation challenge and what guide error is small enough relative to that intentional signal?
records.decision: Use a rotated-heading 0/+3.5/-3.5 degree steering-yaw equivalence qualification. 3.5 degrees is 10% of the current JV-Web 35-degree temporary driving full-lock scale. Remove the remaining world linear-Z lock, qualify fully free translation at 0 degrees first, and carry the 120 Hz angular guide unchanged.
records.scope: Research-instrument budget for this specific bounded orientation qualification. It is not a product suspension tolerance and does not retroactively reclassify the historical 100-microradian gate.

records.question: Can the post-RH0 local-axis mount remove the historical world linear-Z lock and still reproduce RQ0-like straight rolling at 0 degrees before yaw?
records.outcome: Contact/vertical and 120 Hz angular guide remained healthy, but free translation produced max heading error 0.858248 degrees, max cross-heading speed 14.980474 mm/s, max cross-track 3.792284 mm and max slip 0.0268817 mm/s.
records.scope: 0-degree apparatus control only; yaw pair skipped.
records.routing: Add mechanically local translational cross-heading guidance; do not route to higher angular stiffness.

records.question: Can a local H-prismatic -> Y-prismatic -> spherical-center helper-body carrier remove cross-heading drift while preserving heading/vertical travel and free wheel spin?
records.outcome: Contact/vertical and angular guide remained healthy, but carrier failed with max heading error 1.31736 degrees, max cross-heading speed 22.9966 mm/s, max slip 0.0393391 mm/s and max center error 1.48364 mm.
records.scope: 0-degree apparatus control only; yaw pair skipped.

records.question: Where does forbidden cross-heading error accumulate in the failed RQ2C1 multi-joint carrier?
records.outcome: RQ2C1 primary non-drift confirmed. Forbidden cross-heading displacement accumulated across every translational stage; pinned generic joint default softness was localized as a concrete mechanism capable of producing the chain compliance.
records.scope: Read-only diagnostic rerun of already-failed RQ2C1 physics.

records.question: Can the RQ2C1 multi-joint carrier qualify at the strongest effective generic-constraint stiffness natively available in the pinned solver?
records.outcome: 240 Hz generic constraints reduced center/cross-track compliance but worsened heading speed/error and slip. Multi-joint carrier topology falsified for this qualification.
records.scope: 0-degree maximum-native falsifier; yaw pair skipped.
records.routing: Close generic hertz sweep and helper-body carrier; seek one direct local translational constraint.

records.question: Can one direct scalar local translational guide replace the falsified helper-body chain while preserving the existing angular guide and rolling freedoms?
records.outcome: Direct one-axis topology removed material positional wandering, but soft relaxation left max heading error 0.04951397 degrees and max slip 0.03457069 mm/s; 0-degree control failed.
records.scope: Direct research-only guide, 0 degrees only; yaw pair skipped.
records.routing: Test engine-native hard-relax semantics without changing topology, parameters or gates.

records.question: Does making the direct scalar guide follow pinned hard-equality relaxation semantics remove RQ2C3 residual heading error without changing the physical scenario?
records.outcome: Heading/cross-heading guide became effectively exact while legacy max rolling slip remained 0.034689903 mm/s; 0-degree slip gate still failed.
records.scope: Trusted 0-degree control; yaw pair skipped.
records.routing: Audit slip instrument on exact same physics before changing any gate or physics.

records.question: Is the remaining RQ2C4 slip signature mainly a fixed-radius measurement artifact under small angular compliance?
records.outcome: Exact RQ2C4 primary non-drift passed. Actual support-witness max slip 0.034093857 mm/s retained 98.2818% of legacy max, falsifying fixed-radius artifact as the primary blocker.
records.scope: Read-only telemetry on exact RQ2C4 0-degree physics.

records.question: Does the real support-witness residual come mainly from rolling-pair closure error or non-spin/nutation angular velocity?
records.outcome: Rigid-body reconstruction passed. At peak witness 0.034093857 mm/s, rolling pair contributed +0.034570694 mm/s while non-spin contributed -0.000464480 mm/s. Maximum blocker is rolling-pair dominant.
records.scope: Read-only decomposition on exact RQ2C4D 0-degree physics; not contact-solver causality.
records.routing: Do not run a 240 Hz angular comparison now. Next localize rolling-pair closure into COM tangential velocity, axle spin rate and exact support/spin-lever evolution.

records.question: Which initialized-closure term drives the real RQ2C4 rolling-pair residual: COM tangential drift, current-axle spin-rate drift or exact support/spin-lever evolution?
records.outcome: Initialized rolling pair is exactly closed. At peak rolling-pair residual +0.034570694 mm/s, COM tangential drift contributes +0.004529953 mm/s, axle-spin-rate evolution +0.030174406 mm/s and geometric lever evolution -0.000109348 mm/s. Spin-rate evolution supplies about 87.3% of the peak rolling-pair magnitude.
records.scope: Read-only 0-degree kinematic localization on exact RQ2C4D/E physics. Actual-support max slip remains 0.034093857 mm/s, 17.0469x above the frozen 0.002 mm/s gate. This is not contact-solver causality and yaw was not executed.
records.routing: Use source review only to identify plausible/direct ownership paths. Do not infer exact per-subsystem solver causality from post-step kinematics.

records.question: Does source inspection close enough ownership of the RQ2C4F spin-rate drift to justify another solver-level diagnostic before ending routine micro-forensics?
records.decision: PARTIAL / STOP. Contact tangential friction is the unique obvious first-order direct axle-torque path in the exact aligned apparatus, but finite joint/inertia/gyroscopic numerical coupling is not proven identically zero and the exact per-substep Delta-omega budget is not closed.
records.scope: Source-grounded ownership boundary only; not a causal solver PASS.
records.reopenTrigger: Reopen exact solver ownership only if a later decision depends on salvaging this direct-guide qualification, or representative vehicle evidence makes the residual materially consequential for grip, energy, handling or Owner-observable behavior.

currentMilestone.routing: Do not automatically build solver-level ownership instrumentation, run +/-3.5-degree yaw, tune stiffness/contact/solver physics, relax gates or promote wheel-mode5. Re-ground at broader JV-Web level and choose the next work from current Owner priorities.
